name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/widgets
description: Preact widgets for cgc-mdx pages, one subpath export each (`/pdf-viewer`, `/bluesky-post`), and `/bluesky`, the Bluesky client and renderer the second is built on. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist; the page's bundler (cgc-mdx) compiles it (ADR-0005). One subpath per widget, plus the non-widget `/bluesky`, and no root export, so one import never pulls in another widget (#36).
//sideEffects: A widget imports its own stylesheet for its side effect, which a bundler that honours this field (webpack) would drop under `false`. esbuild keeps CSS either way.
//scripts: draw-icons.mjs imports the icons library's TypeScript source, so Node strips its types (unflagged only from Node 22.18; the repo's .nvmrc is 22.16).
//dependencies: PDF.js is bundled into the widget's chunk, never fetched from a CDN. Pinned exactly: pdf-viewer.css carries PDF.js's text-layer rules, prefixed by hand, which must match the TextLayer that writes the markup.
//peerDependencies: The host's Preact: cgc-mdx pins every widget's preact imports to the host Quartz's copy, so one Preact per page. A peer only, never a devDependency too, so no second copy installs here; the typecheck reads Quartz Core's (tsconfig.json).
//devDependencies: The library-CSS check the lint target runs (@chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check); and the icons library, which draws the icons a widget shows in the browser into its committed icons.ts (docs/adr/0002). Libraries depend on each other by `workspace:*` (ADR-0005).
